# 🧪 Algorithm Benchmark Specification

## Question
What performance or quality property is being measured?

## Formal algorithm
Name, reference and assumptions.

## Dataset
Synthetic/approved provenance, schema, seed, size and split.

## Baselines
Include a simple baseline and explain its limitations.

## Metrics
Define metrics before execution and distinguish training/validation/test.

## Procedure
Environment, repetitions, random seeds and stopping criteria.

## Results
Record actual data only, with variability.

## Validity threats
Leakage, selection bias, small samples, numerical instability and implementation incompleteness.

## Reproduction
Commit, environment and command.
